items.t: Figma: Existential Crisis And Dilution Make It Lackluster
items.sum: The Figma stock is rated a Sell, as shares have been down 80% since IPO, and AI competition, dilution, and no GAAP profit make its valuation too risky.

items.t: Docusign vs. Figma: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.sum: Two software giants with very different financial profiles, one a cash-generating incumbent and the other a fast-growing disruptor, both vying for corporate software budgets.

items.t: Figma vs. Fastly: Which Cloud Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
